## v0.14

2026-11-24 · [all changes since v0.13](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/compare/v0.13...v0.14)

### Features
{: .no_toc }

  - warning toast when an action failed after a committed write (YAC-Warning header) ([f779fdb](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/f779fdb))

### Fixes
{: .no_toc }

  - type check passes again (types of react-router/dom, availability of no backend) ([b6bd0bf](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/b6bd0bf))
  - no commit while a validation is still pending after the wait ([40c5d82](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/40c5d82))
  - send Strict-Transport-Security with every response ([5599f2b](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/5599f2b))
  - a value named like a member of Object.prototype no longer breaks the list (aliases, log renderers, patches), page error boundary ([67ee7d3](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/67ee7d3))
  - Regenerate wins over a pending typed value, an oversized charset is a spec error, a limit bar draft ends with a no-op commit, the column search width is not read from a ref during render ([d0b3d53](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/d0b3d53))
  - a second click does not run a running action again, a failed action no longer leaves its button busy ([46708b0](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/46708b0))
  - mac_address shows the address as it is stored and honours default and initial ([9839858](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/9839858))
  - the form falls back to the last tab when the active one disappears, tab error marks are registered per mounted layout ([33e3d91](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/33e3d91))
  - reloading the list keeps the current page (or the last one left) ([4657bee](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/4657bee))
  - a failed log poll keeps the logs shown and stays silent, entries without a parsable time sort last ([aa59b87](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/aa59b87))
  - string lists and the SSH key upload cannot be changed in a read-only form, a removal is not undone by a pending add ([4190a30](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/4190a30))
  - list rows keep their own state when a row above them is removed, pending edits land before the removal ([fc00612](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/fc00612))
  - clearing a date removes the value, clearing an item of a string list empties it (no "" date, no null item) ([0517ae9](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/0517ae9))
  - a required select accepts its preselected initial option (committed when the user opens the list and leaves it) ([52d0566](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/52d0566))
  - the confirm dialog ignores outside clicks while hidden, Enter no longer triggers the button behind it or overrides a focused dialog button ([61d8272](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/61d8272))
  - a pending input is committed, not dropped, when its control unmounts (e.g. on a tab switch) ([4f83931](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/4f83931))
  - selects for integer, number and null enums (JSON type check instead of typeof) ([d1a2bf5](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/d1a2bf5))
  - the read route requires an entity name ([819f495](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/819f495))
  - a pending column search does not fire into the next list ([6d077f5](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/6d077f5))
  - no "not shown in the form" finding for stored data echoed as a bare enum ([25c9870](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/25c9870))
  - field help hover only in the entity document ([9152357](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/9152357))
  - changed or removed defaults no longer overwrite values the user set ([9499ec5](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/9499ec5))
  - the Monaco schema patch only rewrites const/enum keywords, not properties or data of that name ([18df5a1](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/18df5a1))
  - unset stripped keys below numeric-looking object keys ([681421e](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/681421e))
  - locked regions hold against paste, shortcuts, further cursors and line joins ([f591263](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/f591263))
  - a cursor on the first character of a key resolves to that key, example values replace only their entry and respect locks ([b341042](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/b341042))
  - nested defaults reach the YAML, a schema Ajv cannot compile no longer wedges the validation ([93d6945](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/93d6945))
  - the placeholder text of a failed load is no edit (not dirty, not validated) ([5a77273](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/5a77273))
  - another editing target remounts the edit frame, the unsaved-changes guard covers edit/A -> edit/B ([c42c5bd](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/c42c5bd))
  - load the schema once per editing session, never join the load of an abandoned session ([00ef48d](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/00ef48d))
  - create-name navigation encodes the name, replaces the history entry and follows only valid names ([76a4107](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/76a4107))
  - a new name in edit mode is a committable change, navigate to the renamed entity ([a6670af](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/a6670af))
  - meta revalidation waits for in-flight validations, spinner follows the pending count ([260cc6a](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/260cc6a))
  - load the form again after the edit frame was remounted (Reload, Retry) ([7e8e80c](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/7e8e80c))
  - YAML validation in read mode sends a read, not a create ([fa1fe31](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/fa1fe31))
  - random strings longer than 32768 characters, reject an empty alphabet ([a83f761](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/a83f761))
  - survive non-JSON values in the local storage ([e1e8a18](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/e1e8a18))
  - keep the PKCE verifier and nonce of a login per tab ([2c3f39f](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/2c3f39f))
  - a logs 404 reloads the list only once per entity ([f45d277](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/f45d277))
  - readable toast for request-validation errors (422 detail list) ([d16bcce](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/d16bcce))
  - allow-list the origin of a backend URL in the CSP, not its path ([65774dc](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/65774dc))
  - accept unknown fields and a null yaml in backend responses ([e34ad4f](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/e34ad4f))
  - remove tokens and identity when the session expired, keep the session on a transient renewal failure ([de9c1e1](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/de9c1e1))
  - no token renewal loop when the client clock runs ahead ([e32b618](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/e32b618))
  - do not cache error responses, drop answers of fetches invalidated in flight ([6da8f7d](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/6da8f7d))
  - send the CSP as a response header with index.html, lock down the favicon ([80084e7](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/80084e7))
  - prototype-safe data paths, plain-text editor hovers, encoded API path segments ([a18c8b3](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/a18c8b3))
  - public OIDC client without secret, logout revokes the refresh token ([69fa4b6](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/69fa4b6))
  - strict sanitizing of Markdown log content, SVG references limited to fragments ([a1e7649](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/a1e7649))
  - nginx 1.31.9 security release (nginx/nginx-unprivileged, nginxinc/\* namespace no longer updated) ([89beecb](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/89beecb))

### Performance
{: .no_toc }

  - the editor helpers parse an unchanged YAML text once ([db02a95](https://github.com/yac-vays/vays/commit/db02a95))
